versions.changelog:
- Initial release of alibabacloud-oss-access-log-trace-diagnosis.
- Diagnose OSS request failures (403, 404, SignatureDoesNotMatch, EC errors) and trace object access using customer's own logs and configuration.
- Strictly read-only operation: never performs any mutating actions or handles credentials directly.
- Mandatory use of provided diagnosis scripts to ensure robust, auditable and non-fabricated results.
- Provides clear verdict classes, degradation handling, and console guidance if logs are not accessible.
- Automatically verifies configuration and usage questions against official OSS documentation, citing only verified URLs.
